# MCP Tool Inventory

<!-- generated by scripts/list-tools.ts; do not edit by hand -->
<!-- regenerate with `npm run tools:inventory`; preflight enforces sync via tools:inventory-check -->

**Total registered tools:** 81.

The server exposes three tool profiles selected at boot via the `MCP_TOOLS_PROFILE` env var (set in your `claude_desktop_config.json`). Tools listed under a profile appear in `tools/list` when that profile is active; tools excluded from a profile are not registered at all (no token cost in the agent context).

See [README.md § Configuring tool profiles](../README.md#configuring-tool-profiles) for setup. To resurrect a tool that has been permanently removed (rather than profile-hidden), see [TOOL-ARCHIVE.md](TOOL-ARCHIVE.md).

## Profile counts

| Profile | Tool count | Average description length | Tools over 600 chars | Tools over 1000 chars |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `core` | 26 | 767 chars | 12 | 4 |
| `experimental` | 81 | 644 chars | 33 | 6 |
| `full` | 81 | 644 chars | 33 | 6 |

## core profile (26 tools)

Default-recommended unified surface for conversational tone-building. Smallest agent context. Set `MCP_TOOLS_PROFILE=core` to select.

| Tool | Description length | First sentence |
|---|---|---|
| `apply_preset` | 993 ⚠ | Build a fresh preset in one structured call. |
| `apply_setlist` | 702 ⚠ | DESTRUCTIVE: bulk switch + apply + save per entry across a list. |

| `find_compatible_types` | 746 ⚠ | Given a block + knob names you plan to write, return the subset of block.type values that expose EVERY listed knob (AND-semantics). |

| `list_midi_ports` | 460 | List every MIDI input + output port the OS exposes. |

| `nudge_param` | 1571 ⚠️ over 1000 | Nudge a continuous param up or down by one device-defined step. |
| `play_chord` | 485 | Audition the active patch by playing simultaneous MIDI notes (optionally staggered by `strum_ms`). |

| `port_preset` | 989 ⚠ | Translate a Fractal preset from one device to a sibling device (AM4 / Axe-Fx II / III). |

| `set_block` | 366 | Place or clear a block at a slot in the signal chain. |

| `set_params` | 431 | Batch-write parameters on a device. |
| `switch_preset` | 402 | Load a stored preset into the working buffer. |
| `switch_scene` | 336 | Change the active scene within the current preset. |
| `toggle_bypass` | 600 | Atomically flip a block's bypass state in one wire round-trip, no value to pass. |
